title: tidy_build_synced
description: RESERVED for Phase 6B (T6.13) — shape from tidy-prd.md §7 tidy_buildSynced, FR-22, FR-23, §8; not routed yet. CEP WNC_TIDY.buildSynced (signed bridge). Podcast sync: a new sequence '<project> - Synced' in '06 Sequences', settings from Cam 1's longest clip, tracks added through QE addTracks and re-read, Cam n on video track n (an overlapping clip gets a new track, never overwrites an angle), mics on the audio tracks after the last camera one, every placement read back within one frame and mismatches reported; existing sequences untouched. UXP cannot add audio tracks (T3b red), so uxp is false.

bin.description: the bin to create it in

first.description: what 'first' carries (the clip whose settings the sequence takes?) is not stated in the PRD, left open

nodeId.description: project item nodeId (bins are found by nodeId, never by path: tidy-prd.md §8)

start.description: placement, sequence seconds (the earliest clip starts at 0, FR-22)

track.description: track index (0-based, as Premiere's DOM numbers tracks)

nodeId.description: project item nodeId (bins are found by nodeId, never by path: tidy-prd.md §8)

placed.description: placements made (a count or the list): its type is not stated in the PRD, left open

sequence.description: the new sequence (name or object): its type is not stated in the PRD, left open

videoTracks.description: video tracks used: its type is not stated in the PRD, left open

audioTracks.description: audio tracks used: its type is not stated in the PRD, left open

micTrack.description: the first mic track: its type is not stated in the PRD, left open

items.description: one mismatch or failure; item shape not stated in the PRD

readback.description: {placed,sequence,videoTracks,audioTracks,micTrack,problems}. The object stays open: the PRD lists these keys, keys the host adds are not rejected.
